definitions.active_energy_fj: Signed main+retention DC delivered energy, 20–60 ns
definitions.quiet_power_uw: Mean signed DC delivered power, 25–65 ns
definitions.sequence_energy_fj: Signed DC delivered energy, 19–75 ns, includes entry/hold/wake
definitions.transition_excess_fj: Sequence energy minus quiet-power × 56 ns; an excess relative to quiet baseline, not isolated switch energy
definitions.snm: Smaller of largest axis-aligned squares in two butterfly lobes; piecewise-linear VTCs
definitions.state_survived: Both nodes beyond 80%/20% of instantaneous cell rail throughout 25–65 and 75–100 ns; functional criterion, not SNM
